title: Battle of Ugentana
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Ugentana", at revision 1373042668, opens: "The Battle of Ugentana, also known as Battle of Ugentana River was a military operation that took place in 1535, between Portuguese forces and those of Sultan Alauddin Riayat Shah II of Johor." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q116214211, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1536 successful Portuguese attack on Ugentana". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
